requirements.proposition_to_establish: Areas where prescribed plant or plant products are prepared are not contaminated by chemicals.
requirements.criterion_quote: contaminate areas where prescribed plant or plant products are prepared

query_sources.quote: contaminate areas where prescribed plant or plant products are prepared

The integrity of prescribed plants or plant products in relation to which export operations are carried out at an accredited property must be ensured while the plants or plant products are at the property.
